text:
Asha: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting a condensed SI onboarding playbook that covers both hardware integrators and cloud marketplace partners. Need input on training tracks and cert gates.
Tom: love it. Can we include a lightweight marketplace listing checklist? vendors always miss IAM + billing flow steps.
Priya: Yep. Also we should tie the cert to a demo scenario: deploy on Dedicated -> run perf smoke -> verify routing/policy. Keeps it practical.
Liam: Agree. For training tracks I'd separate: 1) Installer (HW rack + networking), 2) Integrator (API + orchestration), 3) Ops (monitoring, rollouts). Each with a 2-hr hands-on lab.
Asha: That split seems good. For cert gates I'm thinking: written quiz (25 q), one end-to-end lab (scripted), and a troubleshooting viva (15 min).
Tom: what's pass bar? 80% on quiz? lab must complete within 75m?
Priya: 80 + complete lab + viva demo ok. Fail retrain pathway: 1 targeted lab + reattempt viva in 2 weeks.
partner-onboard-bot: reminder scheduled -> SI enablement kickoff: 2024-11-06 16:00 UTC. :calendar:
Liam: For labs, propose infra: 1x small Dedicated node (pinned model), 1x marketplace staging account, sample corp dataset (anonymized). Script:
```
# lab flow (high level)
1. register marketplace app
2. deploy on dedicated pool
3. run perf smoke (sample workloads)
4. validate KV cache and fallback behavior
```
Tom: Can we add a quick "announce jointly" checklist — PR draft, partner quote, docs link, marketplace listing live date. I can own PR draft.
Asha: Perfect. @Tom please put PR draft in this thread when ready. @Priya can you draft the partner-facing lab guide? @Liam please build the quiz bank.
Priya: on it — will drop draft by EOD Friday.
Liam: quiz bank will be a Google doc, I'll post link before the kickoff.
Asha: Thanks team. Next step: harvest existing SI feedback (tickets + past runbooks) and fold into the playbook draft. I'll stitch and share a first pass by Tuesday.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Priya: :raised_hands:
Asha: tagging follow-ups for the enablement: roadmap, lab infra, certification rubric, announcement plan. We'll iterate in office hours Thursday.
